what.text: This page follows refugees from Cameroon living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6156 Cameroonian refugees in the United States, 4.4% of all refugees from Cameroon.
Nigeria hosts the most Cameroonian refugees, followed by Chad, the United States and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Ambazonia territory in Cameroon in every year from 2017 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Cameroon with JAS, and with the Islamic State group, in some years from 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 19 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 7420, at the end of 2009.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2005 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
